University Hosts Japanese Delegation for Research Collaboration

Galgotias University hosted a delegation from Japan to explore collaborations in academics and research. The discussions focused on potential partnerships in areas such as green hydrogen, electric vehicles (EV), and semiconductors. This visit aims to strengthen ties between India and Japan, particularly in technological and research fields.
